goal: Extract the cohesive parameter-map management responsibilities from JobParameters so the target becomes a smaller value-object facade while preserving its public API.

ops.details: Create JobParametersMap in the same package. Move the parameter-map field and its cohesive map access, identifying-parameter filtering, and emptiness operations into the extracted class. Update JobParameters constructors and the affected methods to delegate to JobParametersMap while retaining the existing public method signatures and behavior.

Update internal references in JobParameters from the extracted parameters field to JobParametersMap delegation. Preserve equals, hashCode, and toString semantics by obtaining the underlying parameter map through the extracted component.
Add or remove imports resulting from moving the map-management implementation, retaining only imports required by each class.
